values.meaning: Increased Damage Modifier (per 1% of target's missing health, at Cougar/R rank)

mechanics.claim: Javelin Toss damage is increased based on the distance traveled from Nidalee's cast-end location to the target, from 0% at short range up to 225% at 1300 range.
mechanics.quote: increased by {{pp|type=distance traveled|key=%|0 to 225 for 6|525 to 1300}}

mechanics.claim: The distance amplification is measured from Nidalee's position at the end of the cast time, not where she started casting, and has no distinct thresholds.
mechanics.quote: The damage amplification is based on the distance from '''Nidalee's''' location at the ''end'' of the cast time to the struck target's center at the time of collision.

mechanics.claim: Takedown resets Nidalee's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Takedown {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Nidalee's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: Takedown's cooldown starts only after the empowered attack lands (post-effect), not on cast.
Takedown's attack can critically strike, dealing 100% AD bonus magic damage on crit, but Takedown's own damage modifier (missing-health scaling) does not apply to that bonus crit damage.
mechanics.quote: ''Takedown'' can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Nidalee|crit_base}}|100|base = 100}}|critical damage}} {{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.

mechanics.claim: Takedown's damage modifier does not affect the bonus critical strike damage.
mechanics.quote: ''Takedown's'' damage modifier does not affect the '''bonus''' damage dealt by the critical strike.

mechanics.claim: Takedown's attack deals basic damage but is also tagged as spell damage, triggering spell-effect interactions.
mechanics.quote: ''Takedown's'' attack deals {{tip|basic damage}}, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.

mechanics.claim: Hitting a Hunted target with Takedown increases its damage by 30%.
Takedown's damage modifier does not apply against structures; only the minimum damage is dealt to them.
mechanics.quote: ''Takedown's'' damage modifier does not apply against structures; the minimum damage is always applied.
